postconditions.expression: all(0 <= node.val <= 10^4 for node in traverse_tree(root))
postconditions.description: Each node's value is a non-negative integer representing the number of candies at that node, and it is within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(node.left is None or isinstance(node.left, TreeNode) for node in traverse_tree(root))
postconditions.description: Each node has a left child if it exists, and the left child is a TreeNode.

postconditions.expression: all(node.right is None or isinstance(node.right, TreeNode) for node in traverse_tree(root))
postconditions.description: Each node has a right child if it exists, and the right child is a TreeNode.
